title: Agentic RAG Evaluation Knowledge Base Snapshot
description: PR-7f.2c.1.5 Task 2: Offline KB snapshot schema. One NDJSON line per chunk. A snapshot file consists of ONE optional meta line (snapshotMeta) followed by N chunk records, OR a plain NDJSON of chunk records (meta embedded per record). Goal: support gold evidence annotation and reproducible hash computation without runtime DB/Milvus access.

metaRecord.description: First-line (optional) snapshot metadata block. Validator skips this line but the helper uses snapshotId to detect drift.

snapshotId.description: sha256(concat of all chunk content_hash bytes in deterministic order). Single hash that uniquely identifies this snapshot corpus.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier this snapshot covers. Snapshots are single-tenant — no cross-tenant mixing allowed (kb_snapshot_audit.md §5.2).

sourceDbDsn.description: Optional MySQL DSN string (host:port/db) for provenance. Validator does not require.

exportedBy.description: Username / service account that produced the snapshot file.

chunkRecord.description: Per-chunk record. Matches the minimal schema defined in PR-7f.2c.1.5 Task 2 spec. Aligns with MySQL `chunks` + `documents` join (kb_snapshot_audit.md §4.2).

documentId.description: FK to documents.id. Stable across corpus reindexing.

chunkId.description: Primary key of chunks table. Used as canonical join key to Milvus (Milvus.chunk_id → chunks.id).

documentVersion.description: documents.version (nullable in DB). Snapshot materializes null as 'unknown' per Recommendation §2.1. Gold annotation binds to this for semantic_metadata_combo slice.

content.description: Verbatim chunk text as stored in chunks.content. This is the exact byte sequence that will be hashed. NOT shortened/redacted (kb_snapshot_audit.md §5.1).

contentHash.description: sha256(content bytes). 64-char lowercase hex. SAME algorithm as Evidence.sha256 (Evidence.java:85-93) and TikaParsingTrigger.sha256Hex (L405). Validator recomputes from content and MUST match.

metadata.description: Snapshot metadata bundle — corresponds to denormalized MySQL columns needed for gold annotation context.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier — required because Evidence.evidenceId hashes it: sha256(tenant|docId|chunkId|contentHash). Default in DB: 'default' (DocumentEntity.java:67).

chunkType.description: chunk_type column. PART of the chunks uniqueness key (document_id, seq, chunk_type).

seq.description: Sequence within document + chunkType. PART of the chunks uniqueness key.

sectionPath.description: Heading stack from Markdown/PDF section structure. E.g. ['Dubbo','异步调用']. Used by annotators to write rationale (gold_annotation_guideline.md §6.1).

parentChunkId.description: Hierarchical chunking pointer. Children point back to parent (chunk_type=PARENT).

visibility.description: Visibility scope. Validator WARNs if PRIVATE appears (annotation reviewers may need elevated access).

originalFilename.description: Human-readable filename for display in helper UI.

status.description: documents.status state machine (READY/INDEXED/...). Validator rejects anything except READY.
